comments.author: @JuanitaRichards-c4t
comments.text: I live in semi rural New Zealand. Wellington is our nearest city.  I have many Japanese friends in NZ and Japan.  They love to laugh and are very funny people, especially with a few drinks in them. They are very social too. They like the laid back lifestyle in NZ, the shorter working hours and more leisure time and freedom....they can be themselves here and they like our friendly open people.  WE Kiwis love a good laugh and humour can get us through the bad times.  I feel sorry for war torn peoples and the stress they live under constantly....and those who can't enjoy life because of perfectionism and competitiveness and continual striving.  It's not worth it.  I'd rather be poor and happy than be rich and high status but miserable.
